linkedin.purpose: Discover targeting entities such as job titles, industries and geographic entities that can seed prospect research.
linkedin.limitation: This does not directly return a general list of LinkedIn people or companies; person/company enrichment requires an identifier and the corresponding get-person/get-company tool.

facebook.purpose: Search Facebook Pages matching business-oriented queries.
facebook.limitation: Meta documents this endpoint as deprecated for standard Facebook apps and it may fail with permission error #10. The system records failure rather than fabricating leads.
